e.title: Databricks×JSL Medicare 风险调整 (HCC)
e.summary: 美国 Medicare 风险调整官方方案（Databricks×John Snow Labs，18★）：临床笔记自动提取未诊断病症→CMS-HCC 编码
e.body: medicare-risk-adjustment（databricks-industry-solutions，18★）是 Databricks 与 John Snow Labs 的 Medicare 风险调整 Solution Accelerator：用 Spark NLP 从临床笔记（自由文本）中自动提取未诊断的成员病症，映射 CMS-HCC 编码，供 Medicare Advantage/MSSP ACO 的基准与按人头费率使用。对 RIAA：健康险风险调整（risk adjustment）的端到端官方参考——文本→HCC 编码流水线，与 [[databricks-jsl-medical]]（寿险核保风险因子）同族、与 [[hcc-python]]（CMS-HCC 计算库）衔接；Medicare 语境延伸 [[medicare-claims-pricer]]、[[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Databricks×John Snow Labs Medicare 风险调整加速器（18★），临床笔记→CMS-HCC 自动编码
e.summary_en: Official US Medicare risk-adjustment solution (Databricks × John Snow Labs, 18★): auto-extracts undocumented member conditions from clinical notes → CMS-HCC codes
e.summary_hk: 美國 Medicare 風險調整官方方案（Databricks×John Snow Labs，18★）：臨床筆記自動提取未確診病症→CMS-HCC 編碼
e.body_en: medicare-risk-adjustment (databricks-industry-solutions, 18★) is the Medicare Risk Adjustment Solution Accelerator by Databricks and John Snow Labs: Spark NLP extracts undocumented member conditions from free-text clinical notes and maps them to CMS-HCC codes, feeding benchmarks for Medicare Advantage / MSSP ACOs and capitation rates. For RIAA: an end-to-end official reference for health-insurance risk adjustment — the notes→HCC coding pipeline, sibling of [[databricks-jsl-medical]] (life-underwriting risk factors) and linked to [[hcc-python]] (CMS-HCC calculation library); Medicare context extends to [[medicare-claims-pricer]] and [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]].
e.body_hk: medicare-risk-adjustment（databricks-industry-solutions，18★）是 Databricks 與 John Snow Labs 的 Medicare 風險調整 Solution Accelerator：用 Spark NLP 從臨床筆記（自由文本）自動提取未確診的成員病症，映射 CMS-HCC 編碼，供 Medicare Advantage/MSSP ACO 的基準與按人頭費率使用。對 RIAA：健康險風險調整（risk adjustment）的端到端官方參考——文本→HCC 編碼流水線，與 [[databricks-jsl-medical]]（壽險核保風險因子）同族、與 [[hcc-python]]（CMS-HCC 計算庫）銜接；Medicare 語境延伸 [[medicare-claims-pricer]]、[[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]。
